name: leaving-south-africa-tax-emigration
description: How a South African tax resident leaves the tax net, for the 2027 year of assessment (1 March 2026 to 28 February 2027). South Africa replaced financial emigration through the Reserve Bank with a tax-driven exit. Ceasing tax residency triggers a deemed disposal of worldwide assets the day before (section 9H, the exit charge), retirement annuity and preservation fund access waits for three uninterrupted years of non-residency, transfers abroad run through a SARS tax compliance status, and South Africans abroad who never ceased residency stay taxable on worldwide income, sheltered only by the R1.25 million foreign employment exemption. Covers the ordinarily resident and physical presence tests, the 330-day rule, the RAV01 declaration, the exit charge, what stays taxable after exit (dividends tax, interest withholding, the section 35A withholding on property sales, estate duty) and the order of steps.
